title: Vala Afshar (Salesforce Chief Digital Evangelist) — 'a clear-eyed diagnosis and a practical blueprint for change'
summary: Vala Afshar — Salesforce's Chief Digital Evangelist with nearly a million followers on X — endorses Incorruptible as the right book for a moment of eroding business trust, closing with the book's own thesis line.
blockquote:
At a moment when trust in business is eroding, Incorruptible offers a clear-eyed diagnosis and a practical blueprint for change.

Success alone will not protect what matters most. Only incorruptible design can.
